title: Bradycardia
description: Heart rate below the normal range
extract: Bradycardia, from Ancient Greek βραδύς (bradús), meaning "slow", and καρδία (kardía), meaning "heart", also called bradyarrhythmia, is a resting heart rate under 60 beats per minute (BPM). While bradycardia can result from various pathological processes, it is commonly a physiological response to cardiovascular conditioning or due to asymptomatic type 1 atrioventricular block.
